ninja.note: Installed via pip (ninja==1.11.1.2, a Kitware fork wheel with jobserver support), matching the proven manual reference workflow exactly. Ninja 1.13.0 has a known MSVC response-file regression (https://github.com/ninja-build/ninja/issues/2616); do not upgrade past this pin without re-verifying.

aqt.note: Installed via pip (not a standalone hash-pinned .exe), matching the proven manual reference workflow. aqtinstall 3.3.0 cannot install Qt 6.11.x on Windows (pre-6.11 repo folder layout assumption), but Qt is pinned to 6.9.3 below, which still uses the pre-6.11 layout, so no patch is required.

py7zr.note: aqtinstall's optional 7z-archive extraction dependency. Pinned to match the proven manual reference workflow, since aqtinstall would otherwise pull in whatever py7zr release is newest on PyPI at install time.

msvc.note: Pinned to match the proven manual reference workflow exactly (ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd toolset:/sdk: inputs), rather than accepting whatever MSVC/SDK ships on the windows-2022 runner image.

vcpkg.note: This commit's vcpkg_acquire_msys.cmake pins msys2-runtime-3.5.4-2, which has been pruned from every msys2 mirror (404 everywhere), breaking libevent's pkgconf/MSYS2 bootstrap on a cold build. Do not fix this by bumping the vcpkg commit (that drifts every other pinned port's version too). Instead, build_windows.ps1 installs the pinned native pkgconf binary below and passes it through the triplet via VCPKG_ENV_PASSTHROUGH, so vcpkg's own MSYS2/pkgconf acquisition path is never invoked -- the same workaround the proven manual reference workflow uses.

libevent.note: Pinned port version + upstream source REF that the vcpkg commit above must provide, matching the proven manual reference workflow's explicit libevent pin verification.
